description: This file declares the GstDecryptorElementFactory class, which implements the IGstDecryptorElementFactory interface. It provides a factory method to create decryptor elements for GStreamer pipelines, specific to the Rialto media server component.

classes.name: GstDecryptorElementFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating decryptor elements within the Rialto media server, implementing the IGstDecryptorElementFactory interface.

methods.name: createDecryptorElement
methods.description: Creates and returns a GStreamer decryptor element, given its name, a decryption service, and a GStreamer wrapper.
